quarterly_data.quarter: Cerebras press release: Cerebras and Compute Nordic Finland Announce New 165 MW AI (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supplier Compute Nordic Finland: a new Cerebras AI data centre in Mikkeli, Finland, developed with Compute Nordic Finland, will scale in phases to 165 MW of contracted IT capacity (from 50 MW to 80 MW to a full 165 MW), with construction on the initial 50 MW phase already under way. The agreement is a series of service orders each with seven-year contract terms; Compute Nordic Finland leads project development and has operator responsibility. Designed for closed-loop cooling and waste-heat recovery.
quarterly_data.figure: 165 MW of contracted IT capacity; initial 50 MW phase under construction; seven-year contract terms
